assets.name: impact
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready 2D game VFX animation sprite sheet for Unreal Engine. Original hand-drawn anime fighting-game effects, clean sharp graphic silhouettes inspired by simple cel-animated impact design. Main colour vivid purple, small pale yellow-lime inner accent, a little off-white at the brightest initial flash. NO outlines around the atlas, NO grid lines, NO text, NO numbers, NO labels, NO shadows on a background, NO checkerboard, NO scenery. Truly transparent alpha background. Perfectly uniform equal-sized rectangular cells, row-major chronological animation, aligned centre and identical camera/view/scale throughout. Each effect completely contained within its cell with 12% padding. Flat clean two-tone opaque shapes, purposeful asymmetry, pointed wedges and concave curves; no glow haze, no excessive detail or confetti. Animation must visibly change shape frame by frame: fast initial expansion, brief strong silhouette, break apart and fade into very sparse fragments. Final cell almost empty. This is a usable texture atlas, not a presentation board. Square canvas, EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 frames. A compact punch contact explosion with 5 to 7 strong irregular pointed wedges. First frame tiny bright spark; frames 2-5 broad asymmetric burst and bright centre; frames 6-10 open empty centre and outward breaking purple pointed lobes; frames 11-16 only 3-5 dwindling sharp fragments. Organic hand-drawn angular burst, not a symmetric compass star. No enclosing ring.
